title: Arwa al-Sulayhi
summary: Arwa al-Sulayhi ruled Yemen for the Sulayhid dynasty. She married the ruler al-Mukarram, was queen consort from 1067 and, after his death in 1084, became regent for their son Ali Abd al-Mustansir until his death in 1094. At her command the capital moved to Dhu Jibla in 1088, where she is buried. She was given the title Hujja.

uncertainty.note: Birth is given as 1052 (Encyclopedia.com) or "between 1045 and 1048" (Team Queens); death as 1137 (Encyclopedia.com) or 1138 (Team Queens). Capital move to Dhu Jibla 1088 (Encyclopedia.com).
